# components/lightbox

Import: `import { Lightbox, LightboxLink } from "@tundralibs/ui/lightbox"`

Rendered in every variant on the catalogue (`deno task build:demos`, then `demo/index.html`). Guides: [Getting started](../UI-Getting-Started.md) · [rAPId integration](../UI-Rapid.md) · [Theming](../UI-Theming.md).

## Functions

### `Lightbox`

```ts
Lightbox(props: LightboxProps): Html
```

A full-screen image viewer: a native `<dialog>` holding one image at
a time, with a caption, a counter and prev/next/close. Open it from any
element carrying `data-lightbox="#<id>"` and `data-lightbox-index`
(`LightboxLink` renders one — a plain link to the full image, so a page
without the script still opens the picture). Arrow keys, a swipe and
the buttons move between items; Escape and a click on the backdrop
close it, and focus returns to the trigger.

### `LightboxLink`

```ts
LightboxLink(props: LightboxLinkProps): Html
```

A thumbnail that opens its `Lightbox` — and is a plain link to the image without JS.

## Types

### `LightboxItem`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | `string` | yes | The full-size image. |
| `alt` | `string` | yes |  |
| `caption` | `string | Html` |  |  |

### `LightboxProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes |  |
| `items` | `LightboxItem[]` | yes |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the dialog. @default "Image viewer" |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

### `LightboxLinkProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `controls` | `string` | yes | The `Lightbox` id. |
| `index` | `number` | yes | Which item opens (0-based). |
| `href` | `string` | yes | The full-size image — what a page without the script navigates to. |
| `content` | `Html` | yes | The thumbnail (an `<img>`), or anything clickable. |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### Thumbnails that open a viewer

Each `LightboxLink` is a plain link to the full image, so a page without the script still opens it.

```ts
html`
  ${photos.map((p, i) =>
    LightboxLink({
      controls: "office",
      index: i,
      href: p.src,
      content: html`
        <img src="${p.src.replace(".jpg", "-thumb.jpg")}" width="400" height="250" alt="${p
          .alt}" loading="lazy">
      `,
    })
  )}${Lightbox({ id: "office", items: photos })}
`
```

```html
<a class="lightbox-link" href="/photos/office-1.jpg" data-lightbox="#office" data-lightbox-index="0">
  <img src="/photos/office-1-thumb.jpg" width="400" height="250" alt="The office, morning" loading="lazy">
</a>
<a class="lightbox-link" href="/photos/office-2.jpg" data-lightbox="#office" data-lightbox-index="1">
  <img src="/photos/office-2-thumb.jpg" width="400" height="250" alt="The office, evening" loading="lazy">
</a>
<dialog class="lightbox" id="office" data-lightbox-dialog="" data-lightbox-items="[{&quot;src&quot;:&quot;/photos/office-1.jpg&quot;,&quot;alt&quot;:&quot;The office, morning&quot;,&quot;caption&quot;:&quot;Morning light&quot;},{&quot;src&quot;:&quot;/photos/office-2.jpg&quot;,&quot;alt&quot;:&quot;The office, evening&quot;}]" aria-label="Image viewer">
  <div class="lightbox__chrome">
    <span class="lightbox__counter" data-lightbox-counter>1 / 2</span>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn--ghost btn--icon lightbox__close" data-lightbox-close aria-label="Close">
      <svg width="18" height="18" width="2" …>…</svg>
    </button>
  </div>
  <figure class="lightbox__figure" data-lightbox-figure>
    <img class="lightbox__image" data-lightbox-image src="/photos/office-1.jpg" alt="The office, morning">
    <figcaption class="lightbox__caption" data-lightbox-caption>Morning light</figcaption>
  </figure>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn--outline btn--icon lightbox__nav lightbox__nav--prev" data-lightbox-prev aria-label="Previous image">
    <svg width="18" height="18" width="2" …>…</svg>
  </button>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn--outline btn--icon lightbox__nav lightbox__nav--next" data-lightbox-next aria-label="Next image">
    <svg width="18" height="18" width="2" …>…</svg>
  </button>
</dialog>
```

## CSS hooks

Classes defined by `components/lightbox/lightbox.css` — structural, token-driven; override from an unlayered stylesheet (see [Theming](../UI-Theming.md)):

`.lightbox`, `.lightbox-link`, `.lightbox__caption`, `.lightbox__chrome`, `.lightbox__close`, `.lightbox__counter`, `.lightbox__figure`, `.lightbox__image`, `.lightbox__nav`, `.lightbox__nav--next`, `.lightbox__nav--prev`

## Behaviour

`components/lightbox/lightbox.js` ships in `ui.js` (delegated on `document`, re-initialised after a rAPId swap).

Attributes it reads or writes: `data-lightbox`, `data-lightbox-caption`, `data-lightbox-close`, `data-lightbox-counter`, `data-lightbox-dialog`, `data-lightbox-image`, `data-lightbox-index`, `data-lightbox-items`, `data-lightbox-next`, `data-lightbox-prev`.
